verse.name: v1
verse.lines:
The angel of the Lord declared unto Mary
R: And she conceived by the power of the Holy Spirit
Hail Mary...

verse.name: v2
verse.lines:
Behold the handmaid of the Lord
R: Be it done unto me according to Thy Word
Hail Mary...

verse.name: v3
verse.lines:
The Word was made flesh
R: And dwelt among us
Hail Mary...

verse.name: v4
verse.lines:
Pray for us Most Holy Mother of God
R: That we may be made worthy of the promises of Christ

verse.name: v5
verse.lines:
Let us pray
R: Pour forth we beseech thee O Lord
Thy grace into our hearts,

verse.name: v6
verse.lines:
R: That we, to whom the incarnation of Christ, Thy Son
Was made know by the message of an angel
May by His passion and cross

verse.name: v7
verse.lines:
R: Be brought to the glory of His Resurrection
Through the same Christ our Lord
Amen
